title: Seva Bhojan – Food Support Initiative
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Ghatkopar West extended its support to Vishwadharna Warkari Samajik Sanstha by providing food and meal support for 55 beneficiaries.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Ghatkopar West extended its support to Vishwadharna Warkari Samajik Sanstha by providing food and meal support for 55 beneficiaries.

The organisation provides free educational and spiritual education to orphaned, tribal, underprivileged and socially disadvantaged children. As part of our community service initiative, Rotary provided nutritious food to the children, ensuring their immediate nutritional needs were supported while they continue their educational and spiritual activities.

The initiative was a simple yet meaningful act of Seva, bringing nourishment, care and happiness to the children.
